budgetOrLimitStop stops the run when usage.cost >= maxTotalUsd and warns at 95%","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:93,302-304"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#budgetUsd","claim":"--budget is a per-agent USD cap passed to claude as --max-budget-usd, distinct from the whole-run --max-total-usd ceiling","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:100,239,279"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#retryOnLimit","claim":"--retry-on-limit enables a sleep+retry loop only for usage/rate-limit stops (stopKind==='limit'); budget and failure stops are never retried","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:94,489"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#maxRetries","claim":"--max-retries caps the retry loop at 48 (default), with --retry-minutes default 30 min per sleep (48×30min ≈ 24h)","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:95-96,490"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#msUntilReset","claim":"When a limit message names a reset time, msUntilReset sleeps until just past it (2-min buffer) instead of the fixed cadence, sanity-capped at 12h","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:408-418"},{"kind":"fact","subject":"scripts/runner.mjs#budgetOrLimitStop","claim":"Limit detection trusts structured signals (HTTP 429 / stop_reason) and only regexes free-text result when the run errored, so a successful agent merely mentioning 'rate limit' does not stop the run","evidence":"scripts/runner.mjs:290-301"}]

VERDICT: pass — verified usage limits (--max-total-usd, --budget), per-step attempt cap (--max-attempts), and the retry-on-limit loop (--retry-on-limit/--retry-minutes/--max-retries) in scripts/runner.mjs.
